title: The Pink Panther Theme: complete D. W. Barnes source form
composer: Henry Mancini; D. W. Barnes MIDI arrangement

omittedEvents.reason: Omit the lower E2 (MIDI 40) at source beat 352 because it overlaps the upper B2 (MIDI 47) from beat 348 through 353; preserve the upper note and both source durations in the full common score.

omittedParts.alto-sax: Omit the later melodic doubling to reserve one lead voice: unison from beat 587/3, then octave reinforcement from beat 827/3 until the final chord, where its top note doubles the retained piano note at unison. The piano retains the complete melody contour; all original sax notes remain in the full common score.
omittedParts.baritone-sax: Omit the low accompaniment doubling to reserve the independent walking bass and the upper piano chord-tone voice.
omittedParts.drums: Omit GM percussion for the pitched three-voice interpretation; retain the complete source swing, walking bass, chord-tone timing and finite form.
